description: The end-of-meeting detector takes the louder of mic and call-audio level, treats playing call audio as a call in progress, and treats a failed source as no evidence, so listen-only calls are not cut off.

specs.description: Silent mic with loud call audio keeps recording past the no-speech limit
specs.given: A recording with a call-audio source, the mic at a silent level, nobody heard yet, and the call-audio level above the speech threshold on every sample
specs.when: More than the no-speech limit (15 min) of samples is fed to the detector
specs.then: The detector does not stop the recording

specs.description: Silent mic with loud call audio keeps recording past the silence limit after earlier speech
specs.given: A recording with a call-audio source, speech heard on the mic earlier, then the mic silent while call-audio level stays above the speech threshold
specs.when: More than the silence limit (5 min default) passes after the last mic speech
specs.then: The detector does not stop the recording

specs.description: Louder source wins per sample
specs.given: A call-audio source is recording; one sample has mic -50 dB and call audio -20 dB, another has mic -15 dB and call audio -60 dB
specs.when: Each sample is fed to the detector
specs.then: The detector is given -20 dB for the first and -15 dB for the second

specs.description: No call-audio source: mic level alone, as before
specs.given: No call-audio source is recording and the mic is silent
specs.when: The no-speech limit (15 min) passes
specs.then: The detector is fed the mic level only and stops exactly as it did before this ADR

specs.description: A quieter call-audio level never lowers the mic level
specs.given: A call-audio source is recording, the mic is above the speech threshold and call audio is far below it
specs.when: The sample is fed to the detector
specs.then: The detector sees the mic level, counts it as speech, and does not treat the sample as silence

specs.description: Fed level is the max of mic and call level for all inputs
specs.given: Any mic level and any call-audio level in dB while a call-audio source is recording
specs.when: The sample is combined and fed to the detector
specs.then: The fed level equals max(mic, call), and with no call-audio source it equals the mic level

specs.description: Muted mic with other app letting go does not end while call audio plays
specs.given: Speech was heard, the other app has released the microphone (muted), and call-audio level is above the speech threshold
specs.when: More than a minute passes after the first 30 seconds of the call
specs.then: The 'call ended' rule does not fire and the recording continues

specs.description: Call-ended clock restarts while call audio is above threshold
specs.given: The other app has released the mic and the call-ended clock has been running, then call audio rises above the threshold
specs.when: The next sample is fed and call audio later falls silent
specs.then: The clock restarted at the loud sample, so the call-ended rule fires only a full interval after the call audio went quiet, not from the original release

specs.description: Call-ended rule still fires when call audio is below threshold
specs.given: The other app has released the microphone and call-audio level is below the speech threshold
specs.when: The call-ended interval elapses
specs.then: The call-ended rule fires and the recording stops as before

specs.description: While call audio exceeds the threshold, call-ended never fires
specs.given: Any sequence of samples where call-audio level is above the speech threshold on every sample, with any other-app-capturing flags including released
specs.when: The sequence is fed to the detector for any duration
specs.then: The call-ended rule never fires

specs.description: Both silent stops on time with no speech
specs.given: A call-audio source is recording, mic and call audio both below the speech threshold, nobody heard
specs.when: The no-speech limit (15 min) is reached
specs.then: The detector stops the recording at that limit

specs.description: Both silent stops on time after speech
specs.given: Speech was heard earlier, then mic and call audio are both below the threshold
specs.when: The silence limit (5 min default) passes after the last speech
specs.then: The detector stops the recording at that limit

specs.description: Silent call audio does not postpone stopping
specs.given: Call audio is on but at a silent level and the mic is quiet
specs.when: Samples run to the usual limits
specs.then: The recording is not extended beyond the usual limits because of the call-audio source

specs.description: Ended call with the other app released stops
specs.given: A call that has really ended: nothing playing, mic quiet, other app released the microphone
specs.when: The usual limits or call-ended interval elapse
specs.then: The recording stops

specs.description: Adapter passes call-audio level as a plain number
specs.given: The tap or device source measures call audio
specs.when: The level is passed up to the detector's caller
specs.then: It arrives as a plain number in dB, measured in the adapter, not by the detector

specs.description: Detector imports no capture framework
specs.given: The detector's source file
specs.when: Its imports are inspected
specs.then: It imports no capture framework (e.g. AVFoundation, CoreAudio, ScreenCaptureKit) and remains a pure value type

specs.description: Failed call source reports no level and recording continues
specs.given: A call-audio source fails or is unplugged mid-recording and the mic is silent
specs.when: The next samples are taken
specs.then: The source reports no level (nil/absent), the detector treats it as no evidence, and recording keeps going

specs.description: A failed source is not reported as silence
specs.given: A call-audio source that has failed mid-recording
specs.when: Its level is read
specs.then: It is not reported as a silent dB value, and silence-limit timers are not advanced by the missing sample

specs.description: A missing level is no evidence for all inputs
specs.given: Any state of the detector and any sample with a missing level
specs.when: The sample is fed
specs.then: The detector does not stop because of it, and its timers and state are the same as for any other missing sample

specs.description: Settings text mentions call audio
specs.given: The Settings screen under Stop when quiet
specs.when: The text is read
specs.then: It says that call audio counts as activity when it is on

specs.description: Settings text does not claim call audio counts when it is off
specs.given: Call audio is turned off
specs.when: The Stop when quiet text is read
specs.then: It does not promise that call audio counts as activity beyond the 'when it is on' condition
